name: xAI Web Search

env_keys.comment: Comparison only; anysearch does not read a key for this provider.

mode.comment: One server-side Web Search tool; separate X Search and image controls are not fast/deep search tiers.

notes: Comparison only; no anysearch SDK adapter is claimed.

requires_key.comment: Authenticated Responses API request uses bearer XAI_API_KEY.

snippet.comment: Documented web_search produces model answers/citations, not a raw ranked-result snippet contract.

domains.comment: allowed_domains or excluded_domains (up to five) restrict search/browsing; cannot use both together.

country.comment: The web_search parameter table lists domain and image controls but no country bias. Do not transfer X Search settings to Web Search.

language.comment: No result-language filter is documented in the web_search tool parameter table; model language capability is separate.

date.comment: No publication-date range control documented for web_search. X Search from_date/to_date options are a different tool.

safe_search.comment: No configurable SafeSearch setting documented for this tool; model safety is not an equivalent parameter.

answer.comment: Grok searches/browses then produces a model answer with citations.

content.comment: Tool accesses/browses pages for the model; no guarantee of a raw full-page content export in the web_search response.

summary.comment: Generated answer/citations are not per-result page-summary objects.

highlights.comment: Citations identify sources; the reviewed web_search contract does not expose per-page highlighted excerpts.

news.comment: General current-web retrieval can answer news queries; X Search is separate and is not a dedicated web-news vertical.

native_api.value: Model-hosted web_search; X Search is distinct and is not public web search.

rate_limits.value: X Search billed separately: posts/profiles use different units

checked_at.comment: Official public documentation reviewed; no paid API or benchmark run.

capability_basis.comment: SDK availability is separate from native provider capability. Each native feature cell carries its own checked date and evidence.

sdk_support.comment: SDK adapter availability only. See Capability basis for the feature rows; native features do not imply an SDK adapter.

pricing_per_1k.value: Web Search $5 / 1K tool calls + model tokens
pricing_per_1k.comment: Units and commitments differ; do not rank these as equivalent flat per-query prices.

primary_price.basis: Model tokens extra; X Search separate

lowest_price.basis: Tool calls only; model tokens billed separately

free_tier_limits.comment: Trial, monthly credits and model-tool promotions are distinct.
